title: Archicad parity certification
objective: Certify integrated Archicad-class BIM and documentation workflows against a representative professional workflow corpus without changing ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: A representative Archicad-class BIM/documentation workflow corpus is defined and version-pinned before certification evidence is produced.
Representative workflows pass BIM/document semantics and behavioral-fidelity assessment against declared reference behavior.
Representative workflows pass persistence and document round-trip durability assessment with deterministic canonical identities and lineage.
Representative workflows are completed through real Web/Electron UI paths rather than API-only mocks.
Interoperability is assessed with explicit EXACT, LOSSY and UNSUPPORTED outcomes and no fabricated semantics.
Performance and robustness are assessed against declared corpus-specific targets and recorded as revision-bound evidence.
Feature checklist presence alone is explicitly insufficient for certification.
The certified workflow remains consistent with the P019 baseline wherever shared CAD semantics and infrastructure are involved.
Construction Graph, CADDocument, App API, command registry and native engine/worker boundaries remain unchanged and respected.
Certification evidence is reproducible, revision-bound and sufficient for an Architect VERIFIED decision.
non_goals: Claiming unrestricted or perfect Archicad/Revit parity.
Adding unrelated features solely to increase checklist coverage.
Changing Architecture v1.1 without an Architecture Change Request.
Replacing the Construction Graph or CADDocument authority model.
Bypassing the established engine adapter or worker boundary.
risk_assumptions: P019 is VERIFIED before P020 execution.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout certification.
Reference BIM/documentation workflow expectations are documented and reproducible enough to support certification claims.
The P019-certified shared workflow infrastructure remains the baseline where applicable.
evidence_requirements: Version-pinned representative Archicad-class BIM/documentation workflow corpus and reference expectations.
Deterministic BIM semantic-fidelity results for the declared corpus.
Persistence and document round-trip evidence for representative workflows.
Interop evidence with explicit EXACT/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED classification.
Regression proof over P019 and earlier verified CAD/BIM baselines.
Exact-head CI verification and deployment/browser evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering certification implementation, review and final verification.

transitions.reason: P019 is VERIFIED, issue #123 is fully specified with objective, scope, acceptance criteria, non-goals, dependency, architecture constraints and revision-bound evidence requirements; it is eligible for assignment under the repository lifecycle.

Authorize CAD-PARITY-020 implementation to the same logical implementation agent used for the preceding governed parity milestones. The implementation-side stop gate remains PR_OPEN/VERIFYING; Architect owns approval and verification.

Begin the CAD-PARITY-020 Archicad parity certification implementation on the VERIFIED P019 baseline (282993a): the certification-first execution rule applies — the version-pinned representative Archicad-class BIM/documentation workflow corpus and its reference expectations (bound to the version-pinned Graphisoft Archicad 27 reference manifest, every Offisos surface explicitly modeled as a semantic analog — Archicad documents no command-line interface) are defined and pinned BEFORE any certification evidence is produced; then the deterministic certification engine (semantics, persistence round-trip, real-UI command-stream completion, explicit EXACT/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED interop, performance/robustness) is driven against that corpus, with the app-suite certification test, the Web/Electron host-parity convergence, the web-host certification smoke and the Certification workbench corpus catalog. Architecture v1.1 stays frozen (the Construction Graph, CADDocument, App API, command registry and engine/worker boundaries unchanged; the P019-certified shared workflow infrastructure remains the baseline); the implementation-side stop gate remains PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.

The certification implementation is complete at the PR head 27502cb: the version-pinned Archicad-class corpus (the first deliverable — the Graphisoft Archicad 27 reference manifest with every locator verified live, the explicit command-analog map, 8 representative BIM/documentation workflows with the honest outcome spread), the certification engine through the corpus-bundle seam (the P019-certified engine, the P019 fixture byte-stable), the app-suite certification test with the pinned fixture, the Web/Electron host-parity convergence, the TWENTIETH web certification smoke and the Certification workbench corpus selector. The governance gates at the implementation tree: validate 504/504, check-protected PASS, check-verified-revisions PASS, the root suite 199/199, the full app suite 1380/0 fail, web lint/typecheck/build clean.

Submit CAD-PARITY-020 for verification: EV-001 (the full app suite incl. the four CAD-PARITY-020 tests — the certification, the invariants, the auditability, the host-parity) and EV-002 (the pinned certification fixture + the byte-identical cross-host parity through the in-process basis, both host transports and the real web app over HTTP) are recorded; the exact-head CI matrix + the dispatch run, the exact-head deployment with the deployed diagnostic (explicitly a diagnostic boundary observation only — never certification evidence, the serverless ifc_unavailable boundary) and the browser verification follow as the out-of-band PR evidence comments (the P016/P017/P018/P019 discipline). The implementation-side stop gate is honored: the Architect alone owns ARCHITECT_REVIEW → APPROVED → MERGED → VERIFIED.

Independent Architect review completed against PR #126. The evidence package is complete and internally consistent: the Archicad 27 (INT) corpus is version-pinned with a digest-bound Graphisoft reference manifest and explicit semantic-analog partition; the eight integrated workflows cover BIM authoring, documentation, quantities, IFC exchange and teamwork; deterministic persistence/round-trip, undo/redo and replay evidence is present; Web/Electron host parity converges; the real web application exercises the certification smoke and live derived Archicad catalog; exact-head CI is terminal and green; the exact-head preview deployment and browser checks are clean. The serverless IFC limitation is explicitly diagnostic-only and does not support the certification verdict. No protected Architecture v1.1 artifact is changed and no ACR is required.

DEC-001 approves PR #126 for merge at the reviewed implementation head. The acceptance and evidence contract is satisfied: corpus-first and source-bound, integrated workflow certification, deterministic persistence and robustness, real Web/Electron transport parity, explicit interop outcome classes, exact-head CI/deployment/browser evidence, and governance-bound reproducibility. The reviewed changes remain additive to the frozen Architecture v1.1 and preserve the Construction Graph/CADDocument and engine/worker authority boundaries. Merge is authorized; MERGED → VERIFIED remains a separate post-merge Architect gate.

evidence.description: The full deterministic app suite at the CAD-PARITY-020 implementation head 27502cb: 1380 tests, 1335 pass, 0 fail, 45 skipped (the OCCT-gated suites run in CI with the pinned toolchains — the dedicated cad-parity-020 workflow installs OCCT 7.8.1.1 + ifcopenshell 0.8.5 + IfcTester 0.8.5). The four CAD-PARITY-020 tests: the app-suite Archicad-class parity certification (the version-pinned corpus archicad-p020-corpus/1 through the REAL App API handler + the shared prompt-engine command registry with the shell-mirroring story activation — 8/8 workflows CERTIFIED, 52 declared reference expectations with the honest outcome spread 50 exact / 2 typed-unsupported, 14 live interop probes 9 exact / 1 lossy / 4 unsupported, zero failures), the corpus well-formedness invariants, the reference-basis auditability invariants (the version-pinned Graphisoft Archicad 27 manifest — every locator a live help.graphisoft.com/AC/27/INT URL — and the closed command-analog partition over the engine-recorded invoked command stream: Archicad documents no command-line interface, so every invoked name is the declared semantic analog), and the Web/Electron host-parity convergence (the same corpus through WebHost/WebSocketTransport AND ElectronHost/IpcTransport — byte-identical certification verdicts). The P019 AutoCAD certification remains byte-stable within the same suite (the pinned P019 report sha256 3c7d53ff… unchanged through the engine corpus-bundle seam).

decisions.rationale: Independent Architect review confirms the P020 acceptance contract is met at PR #126: version-pinned Graphisoft Archicad 27 reference basis, explicit analog mapping rather than claiming an Archicad CLI, eight integrated representative workflows, deterministic persistence/round-trip and robustness, real Web/Electron transport parity, explicit interop classifications, exact-head CI/deployment/browser evidence, and preservation of frozen Architecture v1.1. Merge is authorized; post-merge verification remains separate.
